common.footerNotice: You are receiving this because you are registered in the address book of {{association}}.
common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:

invitation.subject: You have an account waiting at {{association}}
invitation.heading: Activate your account
invitation.body: The board of {{association}} has created an account for you. Activate it to see news, documents and your own details.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {{association}}
magicLink.heading: Sign in
magicLink.body: Use the link below to sign in. If you did not request it, you can ignore this message.

magicLinkRefused.subject: About signing in to {{association}}
magicLinkRefused.heading: No sign-in link was sent
magicLinkRefused.body: This account uses an authenticator app, so a sign-in link would skip your second factor. Sign in with your password and your code, or with a passkey.
magicLinkRefused.notRequested: If you did not try to sign in, you can ignore this message. Nobody gained access.

moveIn.subject: Welcome to {{association}}
moveIn.heading: Welcome to your new home
moveIn.body: You are now registered at apartment {{apartment}} from {{movedInOn}}. Your account gives you access to news, documents and issue reporting.

moveOut.subject: Your move-out from {{association}} is registered
moveOut.heading: Move-out registered
moveOut.body: Your move-out from apartment {{apartment}} is registered as of {{movedOutOn}}. Your access ends on that date.
moveOut.retentionNotice: Your entry in the statutory member register is retained as required by law. Other personal data is erased on {{purgeOn}}.

boardMoveOutReminder.subject: Move-out to handle: apartment {{apartment}}
boardMoveOutReminder.heading: A move-out needs your attention
boardMoveOutReminder.body: {{name}} moved out of apartment {{apartment}} on {{movedOutOn}}. Service data is scheduled for erasure on {{purgeOn}}.

search.label: Search the register
search.hint: Name and apartment number match as you type. An email address or phone number has to be written in full: they are encrypted, so only a complete value can be looked up.
search.residentHint: Name and apartment number match as you type. Contact details stay with the board and cannot be searched here.

purge.label: Purged
purge.explanation: Service data is purged on this date. The statutory member register entry is retained as the law requires.

empty.title: Nothing matches
empty.description: No entry matches this filter. Clear the search or choose another filter.

error.title: The register could not be loaded

person.protectedOn: Masked everywhere; every reveal is written to the audit log
person.protectionFailed: The masking could not be changed. Try again.

reveal.logged: Every reveal is written to the audit log with your name and the fields you saw.

addPerson.heading: Add person
addPerson.description: Adds a person to the register. Placing someone in an apartment is the move-in flow, which also writes the statutory register entry.
addPerson.protectedHint: Masks this person's contact details and postal address everywhere, and logs every reveal.
addPerson.failed: The person could not be added.

apartment.heading: Apartment {{number}}
apartment.registerNotice: Liens and initial share capital are apartment register content, which is a separate confidential document.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in to reach your housing cooperative's register, documents and news.
signIn.magicLink: Email me a sign-in link instead
signIn.linkSent: If that address has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. It is valid for 15 minutes.
signIn.secondFactorRequired: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.

errors.invalidCredentials: Those details did not work. Check the address and password and try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code did not match. Check your authenticator app and try again.
errors.secondFactorExpired: That took too long. Start again with your email address and password.
errors.unknown: Signing in did not work just now. Please try again.

setup.title: Set up Open BRF
setup.intro: A few steps and the housing cooperative has its register. Everything after the administrator account and the name can be skipped and finished later in settings.

closed.title: Setup is already finished
closed.body: This instance has been set up. Sign in and change what you need in settings.

administrator.title: Your administrator account
administrator.intro: The first account. It manages settings, invites the board and can never be created from this screen again.
administrator.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase of a few words is both easier to remember and harder to guess.

errors.alreadyClaimed: This instance already has an account, so setup is closed. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address could not be read. Check it and try again.
errors.weakPassword: The password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.unknown: The account could not be created just now. Please try again.

administrator.signInPrompt: The account is created. Sign in to continue setting up.

done.title: The housing cooperative is set up
done.body: The register is ready. Invite the board, then add people and apartments in the address book.
done.skippedNotice: Skipped: {{steps}}. Finish these under Settings whenever you like.

resume.body: Some steps of the first-boot setup are still open. Everything there can also be changed on this page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: The housing cooperative's own details, how it sends email, how long data is kept, and your own account.
settings.readOnlyNotice: You can see these settings but not change them.

errors.unknown: That could not be saved just now. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: The settings could not be read just now. Reload the page.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to change this.
errors.housingCooperativeMissing: Name the housing cooperative first; the other settings hang off it.

housingCooperative.title: The housing cooperative
housingCooperative.description: The name goes on the board, in emails and on the register extracts.
housingCooperative.name: Name
housingCooperative.organizationNumberHint: Ten digits, for example 769600-1234. Printed on statutory extracts.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: A housing cooperative often owns several street addresses, one entrance each. The address book shows one board per address.

errors.exists: That entrance is already an address of this housing cooperative.
errors.hasApartments: Remove the apartments on this address before removing the address itself.
errors.notFound: That address is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.unknown: The address could not be saved just now. Please try again.

apartments.title: Apartments
apartments.description: Apartment numbers follow the Lantmäteriet convention: the first two digits identify the floor, where the entrance floor is 10, and the last two digits number the apartments on the landing.

generator.title: Generate a table
generator.description: Fill in the shape of the building and edit the table before anything is saved. No building is perfectly rectangular.
generator.lowestFloorHint: 0 is the entrance floor. Use -1 for a basement.

apartments.draftEmpty: Nothing to save yet. Generate a table or add a row.
apartments.none: No apartments on this address yet.
apartments.duplicateNumber: The number {{number}} appears more than once.

errors.inUse: That apartment appears in the register and cannot be removed.
errors.unknown: The apartments could not be saved just now. Please try again.

branding.title: Appearance
branding.description: One colour, used for positions of trust, links and selected items. Everything else comes from the theme.
branding.primaryColorHint: The whole accent is derived from this one value and measured for contrast in both light and dark mode before it is saved.
branding.preview: This is how it will read
branding.previewRoom: Link and trust sign in the room
branding.adjustedNotice: Darkened or lightened per mode so it holds the contrast a statutory register needs.

errors.unreadable: That is not a colour. Use a hex value such as #7D5F23.
errors.failsContrast: That colour cannot be read on the surfaces it has to appear on, so it was not saved.
errors.pair: {{foreground}} on {{background}} measures {{ratio}} to 1; at least {{required}} is needed.
errors.statutoryPair: This pair carries the statutory register, so it cannot be allowed through.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Uploaded as a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, and served from this instance rather than linked from anywhere else.
logo.lightHint: Used in the room, in the emails the association sends, and on its own website.
logo.darkHint: Optional. The top band is dark, so a mark drawn in dark ink disappears on it. Without this variant the band puts the mark above on a light plate instead.
logo.plateNotice: No variant for dark backgrounds, so the band puts the mark on a light plate.
logo.publicNotice: The logo is fetched by everyone who receives the association's email or opens its website, so it must not show identifiable persons.

smtp.title: Email
smtp.description: The instance sends invitations, activation links and sign-in links itself, through an SMTP server you provide.
smtp.passwordKept: A password is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or clear it to remove it.
smtp.sendTest: Send a test message to me
smtp.testSent: A test message is on its way to {{email}}.
smtp.notConfigured: Email is not set up, so invitations and sign-in links cannot be sent. Nobody can be invited until this is done.

errors.notConfigured: Save a server and a sender address before sending a test.
errors.noEmail: Your own record has no email address to send the test to.
errors.unknown: The message could not be sent. Check the server, the port and the password.

test.subject: Test message from {{association}}
test.heading: Email works
test.body: This message was sent by {{association}} through {{host}} to prove that the email settings work. Invitations and sign-in links will reach their recipients.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: How long service data is kept after someone moves out. The date is computed from the move-out date, so changing this moves every pending date at once.
retention.daysHint: Between 30 and 3650 days. A fresh instance starts at 365.
retention.statutoryNotice: The member register and the audit log are exempt. The law requires the member register to be retained, so no setting and no administrator can delete it.

selfSignup.title: Sign-up requests
selfSignup.description: With this on, a resident can ask for an account by entering their address and apartment. Nothing is created until the board approves the request.
selfSignup.stateOn: On: requests reach the board's queue.
selfSignup.stateOff: Off: the form is closed and accounts come from invitations only.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: Your own language and how the interface looks on this device.
profile.name: Name

security.title: Sign-in and security
security.description: How you sign in. A passkey or an authenticator app protects the register far better than a password alone.

errors.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
errors.wrong: The current password did not match.
errors.weak: The new password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.unknown: The password could not be changed just now. Please try again.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.description: A six-digit code from an app on your phone, asked for after your password. While it is on, no sign-in link is issued for this account: a link would skip the code.
totp.uriHint: Add this link, or the key inside it, to your authenticator app by hand. A scannable code is not built yet.
totp.backupCodesHint: Shown once. Keep them somewhere other than your phone; each one signs you in if the app is lost.

errors.invalidCode: That code did not match. Check the app and try again.
errors.unknown: That did not work just now. Please try again.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with the fingerprint, face or screen lock of a device you own. A passkey cannot be phished, and its private key is never sent to this service.
passkeys.name: Name for this device

errors.unsupported: This browser or device cannot create a passkey.
errors.cancelled: That was cancelled, so no passkey was added.
errors.unknown: The passkey could not be added just now. Please try again.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins add features to this instance. They are installed from the curated catalog and run with the same privileges as the rest of the application, so the board agrees to what each one may do before it is installed.
plugins.restartNotice: The application is restarting to load the change. Reload this page in a moment.
plugins.restartTimedOut: The application did not come back within the expected time. Reload this page; if the plugin is still not listed, check the server log.
plugins.disabledNotice: Plugins are switched off on this instance. Nothing can be installed until they are switched on again.

errors.loadFailed: The list of plugins could not be read just now. Reload the page.
errors.unknown: That could not be done just now. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to see this page.

installed.title: Installed plugins
installed.description: What this instance runs, what each plugin may do, and which personal data it handles.
installed.removeWarning: The plugin's settings are deleted with it, and the application restarts to unload its code.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: The curated catalog this instance reads. Installing from anywhere else is a deliberate change to the instance's configuration.
catalog.unsupported: Needs a newer version of Open BRF

errors.unreachable: The catalog could not be reached. Check the instance's network access and the catalog address.
errors.malformed: The catalog was reached but could not be read. It may be damaged or written for a newer version.
errors.notPermitted: This instance is pointed at a catalog outside the curated one. Installing from it has to be allowed explicitly in the instance's configuration.
errors.unknown: The catalog could not be read just now. Please try again.

consent.title: Review before installing
consent.intro: {{name}} {{version}} is about to be installed. Read what it may do before you agree.
consent.privacyNote: Whatever a plugin asks for, two limits always hold: a person with protected personal data is never shown to a plugin, and no plugin is ever given a personal identity number.
consent.acknowledge: I have read what this plugin may do and which personal data it will handle.

errors.failed: The plugin could not be installed. The catalog entry may have changed since this screen was opened; read the catalog again and try once more.

permissions.addressBookRead: Read names, apartments and residency roles
permissions.addressBookReadContact: Read email addresses and telephone numbers
permissions.mailSend: Send email through the housing cooperative's own server
permissions.jobsSchedule: Run scheduled work in the background
permissions.unknown: Something this version of Open BRF does not recognise

personalData.name: Name
personalData.residency: Move-in and move-out dates, and whether the person is a member
personalData.unknown: A category this version of Open BRF does not recognise

findings.title: Not running
findings.description: A plugin that cannot be run is skipped rather than allowed to stop the instance. These are the ones that were skipped, and why.

reasons.notConsented: On the data volume, but this instance has no record of agreeing to run it.
reasons.permissionsWidened: The installed version asks for {{permissions}}, which was not agreed to. Install it again to review the new declaration.
reasons.personalDataWidened: The installed version handles {{categories}}, which was not agreed to. Install it again to review the new declaration.
reasons.moduleIdentity: It carries its own copy of {{packages}}, which it has to share with the application. It was refused rather than run against a second copy.
reasons.manifestInvalid: Its declaration could not be read: {{issues}}
reasons.apiVersion: It is built for version {{apiVersion}} of the plugin contract, which this Open BRF does not implement.
reasons.entryMissing: The file {{entry}} it declares is not in the package.
reasons.entryInvalid: Its bundle does not export what the contract requires.
reasons.notOnVolume: It is recorded as installed but is not on the data volume.
reasons.moduleRefused: Its module declares behaviour that would act on the rest of the application, which a plugin may not do. It was refused rather than run.
reasons.moduleInvalid: Its bundle returned no module of the shape the contract requires.
reasons.moduleFailed: Its module could not be built into the application, so it was skipped to let the rest of the instance start: {{error}}
reasons.unknown: It was skipped for a reason this version has no wording for: {{reason}}

errors.invalid: One of the values is not accepted. Check the fields and try again.

view.loadFailed: The view from {{plugin}} could not be loaded. The rest of this page still works.
view.notFound: There is no view called {{plugin}} on this instance, or your account is not offered it.

errors.unsupportedType: That file is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image, whatever it is named.
errors.tooLarge: That file is larger than this instance accepts.
errors.unknown: The file could not be uploaded just now. Please try again.
